purpose: Public read-only Horizon receipts for Quittance0 issue 585 fixtures. These records are not asserted to be payments of real Quittance invoices. No transactions were created or submitted.
limitations: The strict-send receipt has memo_type none. A positive memo-bearing invoice test derived by replacing its memo must be labelled synthetic and is not the original transaction.
The strict-receive receipt has text memo off_60cil8zxp. A test invoice may be constructed to expect its existing fields; this is a test expectation, not evidence of a real invoice.
The native claimable receipt has text memo createclaimablebalance and can support a test invoice expecting that unchanged memo. Claimable balance creation is not settlement.
Claimable creation operation contains no balance_id. The retained claimable_balance_created effect supplies it.
Claimable balance resource predicates may normalize relative deadlines to absolute values; operation and effect raw predicates are retained separately.
Testnet history and unclaimed balance resources may change or reset after capture; frozen raw bytes and metadata preserve this observation.
